title: Develop and manage hypotheses
goal: Each hypothesis behind the analysis is written so it can fail: what is claimed, the measure and the line that would settle it, what would show it wrong, and which are already registered as the venture's bets rather than restated here.

steps.do: Read the venture's registered bets and pre-registrations first, and say which of them this analysis would test, so the claim is not reworded here into something easier to pass.
Write each remaining hypothesis as one claim with the measure, the population and the line that would settle it, and the observation that would show it wrong.
Fix the hypotheses and their lines on the handoff before any data is read, and when a later run changes one, append the change with its reason rather than overwriting it.
Hand the claims that belong in the venture's bet register to the strategy function as a handoff, and raise anything the analysis would settle that a decision in force already assumes.

done_criteria.check: Does every hypothesis name the measure, the line and what would show it wrong, and were they all written down before any data was read?
